summary: Sabre Financial Borrower, LLC, an indirect wholly-owned unit of Sabre Corporation, settled its previously announced cash tender offer for any and all 11.125% Senior Secured Notes due 2029. As of the October 12, 2026 Expiration Date, $931.583M principal, about 93.16% of outstanding 2029 SPV Notes, was validly tendered and not withdrawn. On October 13, 2026, Sabre Financial redeemed the remaining $68.417M at 109.250% plus accrued interest, extinguishing the SPV note class. The 8-K is a debt-liability management event, not an equity special situation; no deal terms apply. Watch refinancing, SPV collateral and credit-facility risk.
